 As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions while overseeing multiple projects. You will maintain executive\-level client relations, translating vision into actionable strategies and inspiring others to follow. Your role is crucial in driving business growth, shaping client engagements, and mentoring the next generation of leaders. You are expected to uphold PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where people and technology thrive together. In this role, you will identify market gaps and convert opportunities into successes for the firm, promoting technological advances and creating a healthy working environment that maximizes client satisfaction.

* Mentoring the next generation of leaders and fostering a collaborative environment across the PwC Network

jobs.title: Manager, Application Development, SAP BRIM
jobs.description:
Cardinal Health is seeking a highly experienced, strategic, and hands\-on
 **Manager, SAP BRIM Run Operations** 
 to join the SAP Center of Excellence. In this leadership role, the successful candidate is directly accountable for the stable run, support, and continuous enhancement of Cardinal Health's SAP BRIM landscape.
   

  

 Serving as the premier IT Subject Matter Expert (SME) and operational leader for the BRIM platform, the Manager directs a team of onshore and offshore functional and technical engineers. This role bridges the gap between complex billing architecture and operational excellence, ensuring that subscription order management, charging, invoicing, and financial integrations perform flawlessly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Run Operations, SLA Management \& System Stability
   

  

* Operational Leadership: Lead and manage day\-to\-day SAP Run operations for the S/4HANA system supporting the BRIM functionality, ensuring secure, stable, compliant, and high\-performing system functionality.
* Incident \& Change Management: Oversee end\-to\-end incident, defect, problem, enhancement, and change management processes specifically tailored for all core SAP BRIM modules.
* SLA \& KPI Governance: Work closely with managed service partners and external vendors to ensure strict adherence to SLAs and KPIs for system uptime, support responsiveness, and resolution times.
* Emergency Response: Lead the rapid resolution of System Restoration Tickets (SRTs) and operational crises, providing technical direction and clear stakeholder communications.
* System Monitoring: Oversee the order and delivery flow, batch management, and job scheduling, proactively identifying and automating recurring incidents.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Integration
   

  

* Cohesive Solutions: Collaborate with other SAP and non\-SAP process tower leaders (such as RTR, MDT, and middleware teams) to ensure cohesive end\-to\-end solutions that protect downstream processes.
* Interface Management: Monitor and support critical integrations involving multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, external mediation systems, EDI, APIs, Web Services, and digital payment systems) and lead troubleshooting efforts.


 Innovation, AI, \& Strategic Direction
   

  

* AI \& Automation: Champion and drive the hands\-on usage of AI tools and automated processes to boost operational productivity, optimize team delivery, and drive self\-healing system capabilities.
* Standardization: Influence internal business partners and external vendor teams to leverage standard "out\-of\-the\-box" SAP BRIM solutions, aggressively minimizing technical debt and custom developments.
* Continuous Improvement: Keep pace with emerging technologies and SAP releases, translating business needs into modern system capabilities.


 Compliance, Audit \& Governance
   

  

* IT Controls \& Compliance: Take full responsibility for IT General Controls (ITGC), SOX compliance, and successful audit readiness within the SAP S/4HANA BRIM platform.
* Access Control: Maintain rigorous standards for documentation, user access management, and segregation of duties (SoD).


 Talent \& People Leadership
   

  

* Team Development: Direct, mentor, and develop a diverse team of functional and technical SAP BRIM professionals.
* Capacity Management: Successfully balance available team capacity (resources) against incoming operational demands, support tickets, and minor enhancement projects.
* Consensus Building: Act as a collaborative leader who excels at gaining consensus across business stakeholders, internal IT partners, and offshore vendors.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience), preferred.
* Overall SAP Experience: 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP ERP landscapes, with at least 3\+ years in a formal leadership, managerial, or team lead role, preferred.
* BRIM Specialization: Minimum of 3\+ years of dedicated, deep technical and functional experience in SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management).
* Operations Focus: Proven experience managing SAP Run/Support operations post\-implementation in a high\-volume, enterprise\-level SAP Center of Excellence (CoE). Experience with incident, problem, and change management in a production SAP environment.
* Core Module Expertise: Deep architectural understanding and configuration awareness across core BRIM modules such as: SOM (subscription lifecycles, provider contracts, and charge plan triggering), CM ) (usage event collection, mediation workflows, and rules), CC (charging plans, rating clusters, CC Core Tool, and CDC), CI (BIT processing, billing, and invoicing rules), FI\-CA (payment lots)
* AI Tooling: Hands\-on proficiency using modern AI tools (e.g., generative AI assist, automated testing, predictive diagnostics) to accelerate code review, configuration verification, and troubleshooting.
* Integration \& Middleware: Strong interface experience utilizing IDocs, RFCs, APIs, and enterprise middleware. Experience with Digital Payment Add\-ons is a strong plus.
* ABAP Skills: Ability to read, understand, and debug ABAP code to facilitate rapid issue isolation and system troubleshooting.
* Methodologies \& Tools: Practical knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies (e.g., SAP Activate/ASAP) and experience with robust transport control/change management tools (e.g., Active Control).
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture and operations.
* Experience with SAP S/4 HANA technologies (BRF\+, Fiori Apps etc.)
* Understanding of change management and transport management tools (Active Control).
* Strong experience in translating business requirements into technical capabilities and solutions.
* Functional knowledge of multiple SAP modules (e.g., OTC, RTR, MDT).

jobs.title: BRIM Technical Architect
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:
   

  

 Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross\-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade\-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.
   

  

 Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.
   

  

 Main missions:
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross\-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI\-CA) within the O2C flow
* Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level.
* Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non\-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event\-based integration.
* Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade\-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds.
* Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade\-offs and platform limitations before build starts.
* Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options.


 Tasks:
   

  

* Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level.
* Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event\-driven, API\-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation.
* Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross\-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build.
* Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade\-safe.
* Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build\-vs\-standard trade\-offs that shape future product decisions."
* Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward\-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements.
* Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing.
* Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA.
* Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward\-compatible.
* Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads.
* Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture\-level technical issues.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* 8\+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end\-to\-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations.
* Strong cross\-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns.
* Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level.
* Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non\-SAP systems.
* Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to.
* Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks.
* Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams.
* Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions.
* Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade\-offs legible to non\-architects.


 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!
   

  

 Who We Are:
   

  

 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
   

  

 At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward\-thinking environment.

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant** 




**Location: New York** 




  





**Position Overview**




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on experience across SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), Subscription Order Management (SOM), and FI\-CA.
 



 The ideal candidate will have experience working with usage/event data generated by upstream SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) and will be responsible for understanding and ingesting that data, defining the required downstream processing, and supporting the creation and processing of BITs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work as a functional SME across the SAP BRIM landscape, with a focus on CI, SOM, and FICA.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into functional BRIM solutions.
* Analyze event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM). Understand the structure, content, and business meaning of CM output data and determine how it should be processed within BRIM.
* Define the required mappings and transformations from incoming usage/event data into BITs. Ensure the appropriate BITs are created from the incoming usage/event data and are available for downstream processing.
* Work with technical teams to ingest and validate data received from CM.
* Support the end\-to\-end flow from CM output → data ingestion → BIT creation → Billing/Invoicing → FI\-CA.
* Support FI\-CA processes including account determination, postings, invoicing, payments, and receivables.
* Troubleshoot functional issues by tracing data across the BRIM landscape and identifying where processing or data discrepancies occur.
* Work closely with developers and integration teams on data mappings, interfaces, transformations, and BRIM integrations.
* Create functional specifications, mapping documents, and business process documentation.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production issue resolution.
* Perform end\-to\-end reconciliation to ensure that incoming usage data results in the expected charging, billing, and financial postings.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional issues and validate expected outcomes.



  





**Required Experience:**



* 10\+ years SAP BRIM functional experience/Multiple Hands\-on BRIM Projects
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP CI, SOM, and FI\-CA.
* Experience working with event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with technical teams to implement integrations and data transformations.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working with subscription products would be preferred.

**Job Title: SAP S/4HANA Analyst / Consultant – Communications \& Media (S\&C GN)**
**Management Level:**
* Level 9 – Consultant / Team Lead


**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Gurugram / Pune / Mumbai
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 As an SAP S/4HANA Analyst or Consultant, you will contribute to the successful implementation of digital transformation programs for clients in the Communications \& Media sector. You will apply your domain knowledge, SAP functional skills, and project execution experience to support end\-to\-end solution delivery, working in collaboration with senior consultants, clients, and cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Project Execution \& Functional Support:**
* Support SAP S/4HANA project lifecycle activities including blueprinting, configuration, testing, data migration, and go\-live.
* Assist in process mapping, fit\-gap analysis, and requirement gathering aligned to the industry best practices.
* Configure and test SD, MM, FICO, or BRIM modules based on business requirements under supervision.
* Prepare key project documentation including functional specs, configuration guides, and user training material.
* Participate in Conference Room Pilots (CRPs) and support solution validation with business users.


**Collaboration \& Client Engagement:**
* Work closely with business users and senior consultants to translate functional requirements into SAP solutions.
* Collaborate with development teams to define RICEFW components and support the testing cycle.
* Contribute to cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-implementation stabilization.


**Capability Building \& Delivery Excellence:**
* Stay current on SAP innovations, especially in Digital Supply Chain, Finance, BRIM, and S/4HANA capabilities.
* Develop reusable assets, templates, and accelerators to streamline project delivery.
* Participate in internal knowledge sharing and cross\-functional collaboration.


**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
* Hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, preferably with 1–2 full lifecycle implementations
* Strong understanding of core business processes: Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), and Record\-to\-Report (R2R)
* Exposure to designing functional specs, blueprint documentation, and change requests
* Familiarity with SAP best practices and standard templates for configuration and testing
* Excellent communication and documentation skills; ability to produce clear, structured project deliverables
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
